Authorization checks prevent unauthorized parties from redirecting funds because only the user (msg.sender == user) can override the recipient within a claim call; otherwise recipient defaults to the user or a user-configured recipient. Governance/trusted updater assumptions are explicit for tree updates and dispute parameter configuration. No concrete, non-privileged attack path leading to fund loss or unauthorized state manipulation was found in the provided code.
